title: अंश ५ · अध्याय ३२

items.speaker: पराशार उवाच
items.text:
प्रद्यु म्राद्या हरेः पुत्रा रुक्मिण्याः कथितास्तव ।
भानुं भैमरिकञ्चैव सत्यभामा व्यजायत ।। ५-३२-१ ।।
items.tr:
pradyu mrādyā hareḥ putrā rukmiṇyāḥ kathitāstava |
bhānuṃ bhaimarikañcaiva satyabhāmā vyajāyata || 5-32-1 ||

items.text:
दीप्तिमान् ताम्रपक्षाद्या रोहिणयां तनया हरेः ।
बभूवुर्जाम्बवत्याञ्च शाम्बाद्या बलशालिनः ।। ५-३२-२ ।।
items.tr:
dīptimān tāmrapakṣādyā rohiṇayāṃ tanayā hareḥ |
babhūvurjāmbavatyāñca śāmbādyā balaśālinaḥ || 5-32-2 ||

items.text:
तनया भद्रविन्दाद्या नाग्रजित्यां महाबलाः ।
संग्रामजित्प्रधानास्तु शैव्यायान्त्वभवन् सुताः ।। ५-३२-३ ।।
items.tr:
tanayā bhadravindādyā nāgrajityāṃ mahābalāḥ |
saṃgrāmajitpradhānāstu śaivyāyāntvabhavan sutāḥ || 5-32-3 ||

items.text:
वृकाद्याश्व सुता माद्रयां गात्रवत्प्रमुखान् सुतान् ।
अवाप लक्ष्मणा पुत्राः कालिन्द्याञ्च श्रुतादयः ।। ५-३२-४ ।।
items.tr:
vṛkādyāśva sutā mādrayāṃ gātravatpramukhān sutān |
avāpa lakṣmaṇā putrāḥ kālindyāñca śrutādayaḥ || 5-32-4 ||

items.text:
अन्यासाञ्चैव भार्य्याणां समुतूपन्नानि चक्रिणः ।
अष्टायुतानि पुत्राणां सहस्त्रणां शतं तथा ।। ५-३२-५ ।।
items.tr:
anyāsāñcaiva bhāryyāṇāṃ samutūpannāni cakriṇaḥ |
aṣṭāyutāni putrāṇāṃ sahastraṇāṃ śataṃ tathā || 5-32-5 ||

items.text:
प्रद्यु म्रः प्रथमस्तेषा सर्व्वेषां रुक्मिणीसुतः ।
प्रद्यु म्रादनिरुद्धोऽभूदू वजूस्तस्मादजायत ।। ५-३२-६ ।।
items.tr:
pradyu mraḥ prathamasteṣā sarvveṣāṃ rukmiṇīsutaḥ |
pradyu mrādaniruddho'bhūdū vajūstasmādajāyata || 5-32-6 ||

items.text:
अनिरुद्धो रणो रुद्धो बलेः पौत्रीं महाबलः ।
वाणास्य तनयामूषामुपयेमे द्रिजोत्तम ।। ५-३२-७ ।।
items.tr:
aniruddho raṇo ruddho baleḥ pautrīṃ mahābalaḥ |
vāṇāsya tanayāmūṣāmupayeme drijottama || 5-32-7 ||

items.text:
यत्र युद्धमभूदू घोरं हरि-शङ्करयोर्महत् ।
छिन्न सहस्त्र बाहूनां यत्र वाणस्य चक्रिणा ।। ५-३२-८ ।।
items.tr:
yatra yuddhamabhūdū ghoraṃ hari-śaṅkarayormahat |
chinna sahastra bāhūnāṃ yatra vāṇasya cakriṇā || 5-32-8 ||

items.speaker: मैत्रेय उवाच
items.text:
कथं युद्धमभूदू ब्रह्मन्नुषार्थे हर-कृष्णयोः ।
कथं क्षयञ्च वाणस्य बाहूनां कृतवान् हरिः ।। ५-३२-९ ।।
items.tr:
kathaṃ yuddhamabhūdū brahmannuṣārthe hara-kṛṣṇayoḥ |
kathaṃ kṣayañca vāṇasya bāhūnāṃ kṛtavān hariḥ || 5-32-9 ||

items.text:
एतत् सर्व्व महाभाग! समाख्यातु त्वमर्हसि ।
महत् कौतूहलं जातं कथां श्रोतुमिमां हरेः ।। ५-३२-१० ।।
items.tr:
etat sarvva mahābhāga! samākhyātu tvamarhasi |
mahat kautūhalaṃ jātaṃ kathāṃ śrotumimāṃ hareḥ || 5-32-10 ||

items.speaker: पराशर उवाच
items.text:
ऊषा वाणसुता विप्र! पार्व्वतीं सह शम्भुना ।
क्रीड़न्तीमुपलक्ष्योच्चैः स्पृहाञ्चक्र तदाश्रयाम् ।। ५-३२-११ ।।
items.tr:
ūṣā vāṇasutā vipra! pārvvatīṃ saha śambhunā |
krīṛantīmupalakṣyoccaiḥ spṛhāñcakra tadāśrayām || 5-32-11 ||

items.text:
ततः सकलाचित्तज्ञा गौरी तामाह भामिनीम् ।
अलमत्यर्थतापेन भर्त्रा त्वमपि रंस्यसे ।। ५-३२-१२ ।।
items.tr:
tataḥ sakalācittajñā gaurī tāmāha bhāminīm |
alamatyarthatāpena bhartrā tvamapi raṃsyase || 5-32-12 ||

items.text:
इत्युक्ते सा तदा चक्र कदेति मतिमात्मनः ।
को वा भर्त्ता ममेत्येतां पुनरप्याह पार्व्वती ।। ५-३२-१३ ।।
items.tr:
ityukte sā tadā cakra kadeti matimātmanaḥ |
ko vā bharttā mametyetāṃ punarapyāha pārvvatī || 5-32-13 ||

items.text:
वैशाखशुक्लद्रादश्यां स्वप्ने योऽभिभवं तव ।
करिष्यति स ते भर्त्ता राजपुत्रि!भविष्यति ।। ५-३२-१४ ।।
items.tr:
vaiśākhaśukladrādaśyāṃ svapne yo'bhibhavaṃ tava |
kariṣyati sa te bharttā rājaputri!bhaviṣyati || 5-32-14 ||

items.text:
तस्यां तिथौ पुमान् खप्ने यथा देव्या उदीरितम् ।
तथैवाभिभवं चक्र रागञ्चक्र तथैव सा ।। ५-३२-१५ ।।
items.tr:
tasyāṃ tithau pumān khapne yathā devyā udīritam |
tathaivābhibhavaṃ cakra rāgañcakra tathaiva sā || 5-32-15 ||

items.text:
ततः प्रबुद्धा पुरुषमपश्यन्ती तमुत्सुका ।
क्व गतोऽसीति निर्लज्जा मैत्रेयोक्तवती सखीम् ।। ५-३२-१६ ।।
items.tr:
tataḥ prabuddhā puruṣamapaśyantī tamutsukā |
kva gato'sīti nirlajjā maitreyoktavatī sakhīm || 5-32-16 ||

items.text:
वाणस्य मन्त्री कुम्भाणडश्वित्रलेशा तु तत्सुता ।
तस्याः सख्यभवत् सा च प्राह कोऽय त्वयोच्यते ।। ५-३२-१७ ।।
items.tr:
vāṇasya mantrī kumbhāṇaḍaśvitraleśā tu tatsutā |
tasyāḥ sakhyabhavat sā ca prāha ko'ya tvayocyate || 5-32-17 ||

items.text:
यदा लज्जाकुला नास्यै कथयामास सा सती ।
तदा विश्वासमानीय सर्व्वमेवाभ्यवादयत् ।। ५-३२-१८ ।।
items.tr:
yadā lajjākulā nāsyai kathayāmāsa sā satī |
tadā viśvāsamānīya sarvvamevābhyavādayat || 5-32-18 ||

items.text:
विदितार्थान्तु तामाह पुनरूषा यथोदितम् ।
देव्या तथैव तत्प्राप्तौ योऽभ्युपायः कुरुष्व तम् । ५-३२-१९ ।।
items.tr:
viditārthāntu tāmāha punarūṣā yathoditam |
devyā tathaiva tatprāptau yo'bhyupāyaḥ kuruṣva tam | 5-32-19 ||

items.text:
ततः पटे सुरान् दैत्यान् गन्धर्व्वांश्व प्रधानतः ।
मनुष्यांश्वाबिलिख्यास्यै चित्रलेखा व्यदर्शयत् ।। ५-३२-२० ।।
items.tr:
tataḥ paṭe surān daityān gandharvvāṃśva pradhānataḥ |
manuṣyāṃśvābilikhyāsyai citralekhā vyadarśayat || 5-32-20 ||

items.text:
अपास्य सा तु गन्धर्व्वांस्तथोरगसुरासुरान् ।
मनुष्येषु ददौ दृष्टिं तेष्वप्यन्धकवृष्णिषु ।। ५-३२-२१ ।।
items.tr:
apāsya sā tu gandharvvāṃstathoragasurāsurān |
manuṣyeṣu dadau dṛṣṭiṃ teṣvapyandhakavṛṣṇiṣu || 5-32-21 ||

items.text:
कृष्ण-रामौ विलोक्यासौ सुभ्रु र्लज्जाजड़ेव सा ।
प्रद्यु म्रदर्शाने व्रीड़ा-दृष्टिं निन्येऽन्यतो द्रिज ।। ५-३२-२२ ।।
items.tr:
kṛṣṇa-rāmau vilokyāsau subhru rlajjājaṛeva sā |
pradyu mradarśāne vrīṛā-dṛṣṭiṃ ninye'nyato drija || 5-32-22 ||

items.text:
दृष्टमात्रे ततः कान्ते प्रद्यु म्रतनये द्रिज ।
दृष्ट्यात्यर्थविकाशिन्या लज्जा क्कापि निराकृता ।। ५-३२-२३ ।।
items.tr:
dṛṣṭamātre tataḥ kānte pradyu mratanaye drija |
dṛṣṭyātyarthavikāśinyā lajjā kkāpi nirākṛtā || 5-32-23 ||

items.text:
सोऽयं सोऽयमितीत्युक्त तया सा योगगामिनी ।
ययौ द्रारवतीमूषां समाश्वास्य ततः सखीम् ।। ५-३२-२४ ।।
items.tr:
so'yaṃ so'yamitītyukta tayā sā yogagāminī |
yayau drāravatīmūṣāṃ samāśvāsya tataḥ sakhīm || 5-32-24 ||

en_chapter: Parāçara said:—I have enumerated to you Pradyumna and other sons begotten on Rukmini by Krishna. Satyabhāmā bore Bhanu and Bhairika. The sons of Rohini were Diptimat, Tamrepakshi and others; Jamvabati gave birth to the powerful Samba and other sons. Bhadravinda and other valiant youths were the sons of Nagnajiti. Saivya bore several sons of whom Sangramajit was the chief. Vikra and others were begotten by Hari on Madri. Lakshmanā gave birth to Gatravat and others; and Sruta and others were the sons of Kālindi. Besides Krishna had sons by his other wives, in all one hundred and eighty thousand. The eldest of the whole was Pradyumna, the son of Rukmini; his son was Aniruddha, whose son was Vraja; his mother was Ushā, the daughter of Bāna the grand daughter of Bāli, whom Aniruddha won in war. On that occasion a dreadful onset endued between Hari and Sankara in which the thousand arms of Bāna were cut off by the discus of the former.

Maitreya said: How is it, O venerable Brahman, that a contest took place, on account of Ushā, between Siva and Krishna? And in what manner did Hari cut off the thousand arms of Bāna? I am stricken with curiosity to hear this story of Hari—do thou, O venerable Sir, relate this.

Parāçara said: Having seen Pārvati dallying with her lord Sambhu, Ushā, the daughter of Bāna, was inspired with a similar desire. The charming Gauri, knowing the hearts of all, said to her:—"Do not grieve; you shall have a husband". "But when will this be and who shall be my husband?" thought Ushā within herself, on which Pārvati said:—"He who shall appear to you, princess, in a dream, on the twelfth lunation of the light half of Vaishāk, shall be your lord". Accordingly, in consonance with the goddess' foretelling a youth appeared in dream to Ushā on that lunar day, of whom she became enamoured. When she got up and no longer saw him she was distressed with grief and not caring for modesty asked of her companion whither he had gone. This companion and friend of the princess was Chitralekha, the daughter of Kubandha, the minister of Bāna. She said to Ushā "of whom do you speak?" But ashamed she did not reply. However gaining her confidence Chitralekha heard from her everything. And again Ushā requested her who had been informed of all, to devise means by which she might be united with the person whom she had beheld in dream.

Parāçara said:—Thereupon Chitralekha painted the figures of the most eminent celestials, demons, spirits and mortals and showed them to Ushā. Putting aside the likenesses of celestials, spirits, snake-gods and demons, the princess selected those of mortals and amongst them the heroes of the races of Andhaka and Vrishni. And when she found the portraits she was bewildered by shame; then she took her eyes away with shame from the portrait of Pradyumna. But as soon as she saw the picture of his son, the object of her passions, she set aside all bashfulness and with wide expanded eyes, cried aloud, "This is he! this is he!" Her friend, who was gifted with magic power, requested her to be cheerful and started for Dwārakā through the air.
